preconditions.description: The number of servers n must be between 3 and 100,000.
The number of direct connections m must be between 0 and 100,000.
The index of the server that fails v must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if m < n - 1 else True
postconditions.description: If the number of connections m is less than n - 1, output -1 indicating it's impossible to connect the servers.

postconditions.expression: len(set(connections)) == m and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= w <= n for u, w in connections)
postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly m unique connections, each linking two valid server indices.

postconditions.expression: any((u, w) in connections or (w, u) in connections for u in range(1, n + 1) for w in range(u + 1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The output must include all possible connections between servers, ensuring the system is connected.
